prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity pixel-art NPC horizontal thinking-eye atlas
Primary request: Create a 2x2 atlas of complete 64x35 upper-face cells in exact row-major order: LEFT OPEN, RIGHT OPEN / LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF. Preserve NPC072's current happy expression. Use only the supplied prepared happy reference grid.
Composition: Identical upper-face crop, registration, hair and ornament placement, native scale, lighting, and crisp pixel clusters in all cells. No labels, spaces, borders, margins, or transparency.
Gaze positions: From the corresponding source eye position, LEFT gaze moves BOTH colored iris clusters and BOTH dark pupil cores one native pixel to the LEFT on the image canvas. RIGHT gaze moves BOTH colored iris clusters and BOTH dark pupil cores one native pixel to the RIGHT on the image canvas. This is the same x-direction and similar one-pixel displacement for each eye; do not make the far/right iris move right during LEFT gaze, do not make either eye stay centered, and do not move the pupils in opposite directions. Identify the colored iris/dark pupil center, not its glint. No vertical change. LEFT HALF must keep the exact iris x/y position of LEFT OPEN; RIGHT HALF must keep the exact iris x/y position of RIGHT OPEN.
Blink: In HALF, only the upper lid descends to cover the upper part of each iris; retain the selected happy half-aperture. Keep the lower lid and cheeks stable. Preserve original-locked pixels in rows 25-27 and all pixels below them. No lower-lid lift or cheek shift.
Happy expression/palette: Preserve the reference's own connected happy brows, brow shape through row 19, compact olive/amber irises, dark pupils, tiny muted highlights, shaded narrow whites, and source palette. Keep face and eye anatomy unchanged except for lateral gaze and upper-lid descent.
Avoid: Opposite pupil directions, stationary single iris, cross-eyed gaze, incorrect sign for either eye, more than one native pixel per side from the source, vertical eye movement, broad pale eye bands, enlarged/round eyes, bright glint flashes, changed brows, fringe, cheek, or lower lid.
